import { type JSXChildren, type QRL } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type DateValue, type Locale } from '../../internal/behavior';
import { type CalendarTranslations } from './model';
export type { CalendarTranslations } from './model';
export interface CalendarProps {
    id?: string;
    mode?: 'single' | 'range';
    value?: DateValue;
    defaultValue?: DateValue;
    onValueChange$?: QRL<(details: ValueChangeDetails<DateValue>) => void>;
    onConfirm$?: QRL<(details: ValueChangeDetails<DateValue>) => void>;
    onCancel$?: QRL<() => void>;
    label?: JSXChildren;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    min?: string;
    max?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    locale?: Locale;
    translations?: Partial<CalendarTranslations>;
    referenceDate?: string;
    today?: string;
}
export declare const Calendar: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<CalendarProps>;
